title: OpenWordnet-PT
name: OWN-PT

main.description: The main OWN-PT lexical database, containing synsets, entries, senses, definitions, and examples, linked to English.

provenance.description: Provenance records tracing every data point back to its source and original identifier.

footer: Built by Alexandre Rademaker, Valeria de Paiva, and contributors.

about.intro:
OpenWordnet-PT is a freely available semantic dictionary of the Portuguese language, part of the Open Multilingual Wordnet. It is developed collaboratively using a web interface and linked to Princeton WordNet.

Source code on GitHub.
about.citation: If you use OpenWordnet-PT, please cite Rademaker et al. (2012).  For the interface, please cite Maudslay and Bond (2026).
about.languageData: OpenWordnet-PT covers Brazilian and European Portuguese, linked to Princeton WordNet synsets via the ILI.

publications: Alexandre Rademaker, Valeria de Paiva, Livy Real, Claudia Freitas, Hugo Gonçalo Oliveira, Alberto Simões and Fabricio Chalub (2012) OpenWordnet-PT: An Open Brazilian Wordnet for Reasoning. In Proceedings of COLING 2012.
